title: CodexBenchmarkAdapter
responsibility: Invokes Codex with explicit configuration and validates completed benchmark turns.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.constructor.executable
inputs.description: Native Codex executable name or path.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.preflight.candidate
inputs.description: Explicit runner, model, effort and tool configuration to validate.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.run.input
inputs.description: Isolated workspace, prompt, optional resumed session and abort signal.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.command.input
inputs.description: Candidate settings and session used to form the native argument vector.

outputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.preflight
outputs.description: Installed Codex CLI version after supported-setting checks.

outputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.run
outputs.description: Completed turn with session identity, matching reported model and available usage.

outputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.command
outputs.description: Explicit Codex exec or resume argument vector.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsupported settings, unavailable execution and incomplete or mismatched turns.
